AstralEngine: architecture and runtime flow

Long image

A

Answer

AstralEngine runs its engine logic as browser JavaScript and renders through WebGPU. Node.js serves the local project, while game and editor pages share one V1 runtime: JSON scenes acquire assets, become scene-owned ECS data, and produce draw commands each frame.123

  1. The game page starts src/main.js. The editor starts src/editor/main.js and mounts tools on that same runtime.45
  2. StartBrowserApplication() wires the browser platform, WebGPU renderer, input, assets, scenes, engine, and hot reload.3
  3. Scene documents, asset manifests, input maps, and built-in component records stay at version 1.6789

1

How are the engine parts connected?

The game and editor start through separate modules, then share one application composition root. Scenes own their ECS state and system schedule. The local server serves pages, data, and development events.4532

2

How does startup data reach the GPU?

The browser loads index.html or editor.html from the local Node server, then runs the selected entry module.1102 The entry initializes WebGPU, loads the V1 input map and asset manifest, and asks the scene loader to build the main scene.311 The scene loader acquires assets in a scene scope; the asset manager fetches GLB and texture dependencies.1213

The engine runs fixed updates at 1/60 second, with at most five steps per frame. It then prepares the scene and calls the WebGPU renderer.141516

3

Which contracts stay at version 1?

Version 1 applies to the current persisted contracts and built-in component codecs. The serializer can migrate older per-type records, but the active built-in component registrations remain version 1.179

Project package1.0.0package metadata18
Scene documentastral-scene with version: 1scene file6
Asset manifestastral-assets with version: 1asset catalog19
Input mapversion: 1 named actionsaction map8
Component recordtypeId, version, and data; built-in codecs use Version: 1codecs9, serializer17
Profiler captureversion: 1profiler20

V1 policy

Keep new project data and versioned contracts at version 1. The migration handler remains in place, but it does not require a version increase.

The editor edits the active scene through its authoring controller. Its export path serializes the live scene and downloads a JSON copy; it does not overwrite the project asset. The panel registry includes hierarchy, inspector, asset browser, console, profiler, and memory tracking.212223

The server also exposes a read-only asset-directory API. Its watcher sends asset-change events; the client stages replacement assets and commits them at a frame boundary.2425262728
